name: A Room That Is Not There
description: It has the dimensions of a room and none of the reasons for one. The walls are the colour of whatever you last looked at. There is a light source and it is not anywhere. You are very aware that this has been assembled quickly and on your behalf.

objects.name: the walls
looks: The colour of whatever you last looked at. They update.
They are the right distance away and there are not enough of them.
One of them is doing the work of two, and doing it well.

objects.name: the light
looks: There is plenty of it and no source. Nobody has minded until now.
It comes from about a foot in front of your face.
It dims when you stop needing it and comes back before you ask.

ambient: The room adjusts one dimension and gets away with it.
The light source moves to somewhere more convenient.
For a moment the walls forget their colour, and then they have it.
